document.title: Parameter Configuration Guide - North America I-ETMS® Protect
document.source_file: WEG-DDG-11080 I-ETMS Protect Parameter Configuration Guide - North America (1.4 draft 33).pdf

parameters.name: Authority Violation Timeout
parameters.description: Period for when an authority violation times out if an explicit report has not been received, after which crew will be prompted to verify whether the violation still exists.

parameters.name: Route Based Cab Restricted Speed Enforcement Delay Time
parameters.description: Utilized on route based cab signal track to calculate an enforcement delay equal to (current stopping time x ((current speed – target speed) / current speed)) + TBC12 seconds when the cab signal changes and the train speed is faster than the speed associated with the new cab signal status.

parameters.name: Cab Signal Target Modification Time
parameters.description: Period of time since the calculated position uncertainty behind the leading edge of the train passed a facing signal, entered cab signal track, or exited a known cab signal dropout location after which the on-board segment will update its cab signal targets.

parameters.name: Communication Flag Display Determination Factor
parameters.description: A multiplier to the fast poll rate that essentially determines the number of fast polls that may be missed before sending a poll registration request.

parameters.name: Conditional Authority Prompting Distance
parameters.description: The distance to the zero (0) mph conditional movement authority which the calculated position uncertainty ahead of the leading edge of the train must be within for the on-board to prompt crew to "Indicate Arrival of Engines"

parameters.name: Crew Initiated Horn Protection Timeout
parameters.description: The on-board segment will not activate horn protection unless this minimum period of time has elapsed since the horn button was last pressed

parameters.name: Crossing Malfunction First Protection Prompt Distance
parameters.description: The distance to a malfunctioning grade crossing which the train must be within for the on-board to prompt crew

parameters.name: Crossing Malfunction Warning Speed
parameters.description: The head end only speed limit set at a crossing when there is a malfunction of the crossing process.

parameters.name: Deliberation Distance
parameters.description: The distance in approach to a 0 mph signal target at which the on-board segment will • prompt the crew to proceed past the signal displaying stop, • use a pass signal at stop authority received from the BOS, or • remove the target in the case of a stop and proceed signal indication assuming all other conditions for doing so are met.

parameters.name: Depart Timeout
parameters.description: The time after a departure test has been performed before the next departure test will be required during initialization.

parameters.name: Fast Poll Rate
parameters.description: The poll rate when determination distance is within TBC56 miles from the current onboard position.

parameters.name: Fast Poll Rate Determination Distance (from Locomotive)
parameters.description: If the shortest straight line distance between a locomotive and track in a subdivision is TBC56 or less, the on-board will assign a fast poll rate for that subdivision.

parameters.name: Log File Archive Time
parameters.description: Time duration a log file is written to before being closed, archived, and replaced by a new log file.

parameters.name: GPS Fix Validity Determination Time
parameters.description: The consecutive seconds that may elapse since the on-board segment last set the locomotive track location within a track segment based on a valid GPS fix before setting location and direction to unknown and generating appropriate targets.

parameters.name: Login Expiration
parameters.description: When the time duration ‘since the last crew login’ exceeds the login expiration value and the on-board state is CUT OUT or FAILED, the on-board system discards the stored employee ID, encrypted employee PIN, clearance number, and train ID.

parameters.name: Maximum Log Size
parameters.description: If a log file reaches the maximum log size, the log file is closed, archived, and replaced by a new log file.

parameters.name: Medium Poll Rate
parameters.description: The poll rate when determination distance is between TBC56 and TBC97 from the current onboard position.

parameters.name: Medium Poll Rate Determination Distance (from Locomotive) The upper limit of medium poll rate distance.
Message Advance Limit
parameters.description: The acceptable limit for how far in the future the time stamp of message will be accepted.

parameters.name: Message Delay Limit
parameters.description: The acceptable limit for how far in the past the time stamp of message will be accepted.

parameters.name: Message Retry Count
parameters.description: The total number of times a message will be sent when the expected response is not received. Includes the initial message sent.

parameters.name: Message Timeout
parameters.description: The elapsed since the on-board segment sent a request message before it attempts a retry. Must be greater than the configured TTL for associated 2000 series messages.

parameters.name: Minimum Emergency Brake Reporting Speed
parameters.description: Minimum speed threshold value for emergency brake application report. Emergency brake application above this value generates a report.

parameters.name: Minimum Position Logging Interval
parameters.description: The on-board system logs information from each GPS receiver at a minimum of this frequency.

parameters.name: Moving Parking Flag Enforcement
parameters.description: When the parking function is enabled, if the locomotive moves for a duration equal to the moving parking flag enforcement value, the on-board system displays the braking banner, a ‘Parking Brake On’ brake prompt, and initiates a full service brake application.

parameters.name: Poll Registration Interval
parameters.description: The maximum elapsed time since the on-board segment sent a Poll Registration (02020) message for a subdivision/district before sending a new Poll Registration (02020) message..

parameters.name: Position Report to Owning Railroad Frequency
parameters.description: Frequency the on-board system sends position report to owning railroad.

parameters.name: Position Report to Operating Railroads Frequency
parameters.description: Frequency the on-board system sends position report to operating railroad.

parameters.name: Position Report Suppression Timeout
parameters.description: The minimum interval at which the on-board segment will send position reports.

parameters.name: Predictive Removal Speed Warning Limit
parameters.description: If the on-board is predictively warning for a target, and the locomotive slows to within TBC131 mph over the speed of that target, the on-board will remove the warning.

parameters.name: Freight Predictor Curve Nominal Warning Time
parameters.description: At current throttle and brake settings, the on-board will begin warning when it calculates there is TBC132 seconds before braking is required to be enforced. Changes in throttle and brake settings may cause the actual warning time to be longer or shorter than TBC132 seconds.

parameters.name: Overspeed Braking Limit
parameters.description: When predictively enforcing a target, the projected speed over the target speed at the target limit at which warning or braking may be initiated. Also, when predictively enforcing a target, the current speed over the target speed at which braking may be initiated. When reactively enforcing a target, the speed over the target speed at which braking is initiated.

parameters.name: Overspeed Warning Limit
parameters.description: When predictively enforcing a target, the current speed over the target speed at which warning may be initiated. When reactively enforcing a target, the speed over the target speed at which warning is initiated.

parameters.name: Minimum Distance to Target Next Signal More Permissive than SG-2
parameters.description: When the leading edge of the train is in a restricted speed target or on non-PTC/PTC entry track, the on-board segment will generate a target for a facing signal with a status more permissive than a status in SG-2 when: • The locomotive speed is less than or equal to target speed + TBC291 mph and the distance from the leading edge of the train to that signal is TBC138 feet OR • The locomotive speed is greater than target speed + TBC291 mph and the distance from the leading edge of the train to that signal is the longer of: o TBC138 feet or o Stopping distance plus TBC439 feet

parameters.name: Seconds to Minutes Rounding Limit
parameters.description: Seconds to minutes rounding value for warning banner and enforcement braking. If greater than limit value, system rounds up to next higher minute. If less than limit value, system rounds down to next lower minute.

parameters.name: Slow Poll Rate
parameters.description: The poll rate to be used when the straight line distance to the that subdivisions track is greater than TBC97.

parameters.name: Soft Target Enforcement Activation Speed
parameters.description: The speed over the actual speed of the soft target that when the trains speed drops below this number, enforcement will become enabled for this target.

parameters.name: Software Install Banner Timeout
parameters.description: During the installation of new software during initialization, the software install banner timeout is the time duration the “Installing new software, brakes will be applied” banner is displayed.

parameters.name: Subdivision/District Non-Synchronization Determination Factor
parameters.description: A multiplier to the poll rate that essentially determines how long office synchronization may be lost.

parameters.name: Subdivision/District Non-Synchronization Target Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: When a non synchronized zero (0) speed target is generated, this is the delay time before it is enforce.

parameters.name: Work Zone Target Receipt of Dataset / State Change Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: Enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for a 0 mph work zone target: • until at least TBC161 seconds after the bulletin containing the work zone is received or • until at least TBC161 seconds after the on-board segment state transition from DISENGAGED to ACTIVE. See also Work Zone Effective Time Enforcement Delat TBC249

parameters.name: Exit Notification Distance
parameters.description: The distance past the exit from PTC controlled track that the notification is displayed.

parameters.name: The speed at which the train is considered stopped
Second-to-Minute Conversion Threshold
parameters.description: When displaying the warning banner, the time at which the display changes from minutes to seconds.

parameters.name: Temporary Speed Restriction Receipt of Dataset Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC167 seconds after the on-board segment receives the bulletin or TBC248 after the temporary speed restriction goes into effect.

parameters.name: Train Handling Timeout
parameters.description: The elapsed time since the most recent train handling exception was detected, and the train handling exception prompt is still displayed

parameters.name: Train Route Calculation Interval
parameters.description: The interval at which the route is recalculated if nothing else has occurred to change or update the route.

parameters.name: Train’s Front Route Calculation Distance Miles in front of train for which route is calculated.
Train’s Rear Route Calculation Distance Miles to the rear of the train for which route is calculated.
Unknown to Known Direction Determination Distance
parameters.description: The distance the train must travel when direction is unknown to determine direction of travel.

parameters.name: WIUStatus Message Age Limit
parameters.description: The creation time stamp on WIU message must be less than this number of seconds old to be accepted by the onboard system.

parameters.name: Violation Report Interval
parameters.description: The interval at which violation reports are sent as long as the violation continues.

parameters.name: Violation Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC178 seconds after the on-board segment receives the violation.

parameters.name: Prompt Display Distance
parameters.description: Distance from a joint authority or Work Zone target within which the on-board will prompt.

parameters.name: Target Display Time
parameters.description: The amount of time in advance of the start time of a bulletin of any type other than work zone that the on-board segment will generate a target for that bulletin.

parameters.name: Joint Movement Authority Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for a 0 mph joint movement authority target • until at least TBC184 seconds after the movement authority is received if the leading edge of the train is inside the joint limits or • until at least TBC184 seconds after the on-board segment state transitions from DISENGAGED to ACTIVE.

parameters.name: XTE Limit Cross Track Error Limit
BeaconOn Interval
parameters.description: The minimum interval at which the on-board segment will send Beacon Request messages to WIU.

parameters.name: BeaconOn Stagger Interval
parameters.description: In order to avoid multiple locomotives sending BeaconOn messages to a WIU and potentially disrupting communications, the BeaconOn Stagger Interval is in place to allow the closest locomotive to send the message. Upon receipt of a WIUStatus message indicating that the WIU is about to stop beaconing, the on-board segment will wait for a period equaling: Route distance between device and leading edge of the train in miles x TBC195 seconds/mile before sending a Beacon Request message.

parameters.name: GetWIUStatus Duration
parameters.description: If the known status of the WIU is within TBC196 seconds of expiring and the train is within stopping distance of the device and the on-board segment is not braking for a target generated for that device, the on-board will send the GetWIUStatus message.

parameters.name: GetWIUStatus Interval Time to prevent too frequent WIU status.
Minimum Copyright Screen Timeout
parameters.description: The minimum time the Copyright screen should be displayed.

parameters.name: Minimum Penalty Brake Set Time
parameters.description: During a brake test, the penalty brake must be activated for at least TBC208 seconds before the Toggle Emergency key can be utilized.

parameters.name: Poll Rate Assignment Timeout Poll rate will be assigned once every TBC212 minutes.
Fault Report Elapse Time
parameters.description: If the on-board has not sent a Locomotive Fault Report since a fault status change and the time since the fault status change is at least TBC213 seconds, the on-board will send a Fault Report

parameters.name: Enter Intermittent Fault State Time
parameters.description: When the status of a fault transitions between clear and active more than once within TBC214 minutes, the on-board segment declares the fault as intermittent.

parameters.name: Exit Intermittent Fault State Time
parameters.description: When an intermittent fault has been cleared for at least TBC215 minutes, the on-board segment declares the intermittent fault as cleared.

parameters.name: Maximum PCS Delay
parameters.description: If TBC223 seconds elapse during the departure test and the PCS has not activated, the brake test will fail.

parameters.name: Elapse time for sending Train Control Status Data (0500) message
parameters.description: On-board will send a PTC Status Data message once every TBC224 seconds to Energy Management

parameters.name: Elapse time for receiving Energy Management Status (0600) message. Also used for determining EM Communication Loss
parameters.description: If the on-board does not receive an Energy Management Status message within TBC225 seconds of connecting to Energy Management, the on-board will reset the Class D connection and. declare an EM Communication Loss.

parameters.name: Periodic time for sending Current Position (0530) message
parameters.description: On-board will send a Current Position message once every TBC227 seconds to Energy Management.

parameters.name: Distance for sending Current Position (0530) message
parameters.description: On-board will send a Current Position message to Energy Management if the train has moved TBC228 feet since the previous Current Position message.

parameters.name: Periodic time for sending Train Route (0531) message
parameters.description: If on-board has track location and direction, it will send a Train Route message once every TBC229 seconds to Energy Management

parameters.name: Periodic time for sending Target List (0532) message
parameters.description: If on-board has track location and direction, it will send a Target List message once every TBC230 seconds to Energy Management

parameters.name: Elapse time for receiving EM Display Information
parameters.description: If on-board does not receive an Energy Management advisory message for TBC231 seconds, the on-board will remove the applicable feature from the display

parameters.name: Elapse time for receiving Crew and Train Data Acknowledge (0624) message
parameters.description: If TBC232 seconds has elapsed since on-board sent a Crew and Train Data message without receiving an acknowledgement, the on-board will resend the message.

parameters.name: Elapse time for receiving Target List Acknowledge (0632) message
parameters.description: If TBC233 seconds has elapsed since on-board sent a Target List message without receiving an acknowledgement, the on-board will resend the message.

parameters.name: Minimum time elapsed prior to emergency brake application
parameters.description: The time a predictive full-service brake application must be activated before the on-board initiates an emergency brake application

parameters.name: Minimum speed for emergency brake application
parameters.description: The train speed must be above TBC235 for the on-board to transition from predictive full-service brake application to emergency brake application.

parameters.name: Emergency reserve threshold
parameters.description: During the departure test, the front BPP must remain above TBC236 psi in order for the on-board segment to detect that emergency brakes will be available for any subsequent enforcement braking.

parameters.name: Software installation timeout
parameters.description: The maximum time allowed for a successful software installation.

parameters.name: Fast Owning Road MDM Fileset Synchronization Rate
parameters.description: The rate at which the on-board segment will contact the MDM Server of the owning/leasing railroad when the on- board segment is in a controlling state.

parameters.name: Medium Owning Road MDM Fileset Synchronization Rate
parameters.description: The rate at which the on-board segment will contact the MDM Server of the owning/leasing railroad when the on-board segment is not in a controlling state.

parameters.name: Operating and Employing Road MDM Fileset Synchronization Rate
parameters.description: The rate at which the on-board segment will contact the MDM Server of the operating or employing railroad.

parameters.name: Slow MDM Fileset Synchronization Rate
parameters.description: The rate at which the on-board segment will contact the MDM Server of all other railroads contained in the common configuration fileset currently loaded.

parameters.name: Track Out of Service Receipt of Dataset Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC242 seconds after the on-board segment receives the bulletin or TBC250 seconds after the bulletin goes into effect.

parameters.name: Grade Crossing Activation Failure Receipt of Dataset Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC243 seconds after the bulletin containing the grade crossing warning system malfunction is received or TBC251 seconds after the bulletin containing the grade crossing warning system malfunction goes into effect.

parameters.name: Grade Crossing False Activation Receipt of Dataset / State Change Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for a grade crossing false activation target: • until at least TBC244 seconds after the bulletin containing the grade crossing warning system malfunction is received or • until at least TBC244 seconds after the on-board segment state transistion from DISENGAGED to ACTIVE. See also Grade Crossing False Activation Effective Time Enforcement Delay TBC252.

parameters.name: Departure Test Start Minimum Threshold without Feed Valve Setting
parameters.description: Front brake pipe pressure must be above this number to initiate a brake test.

parameters.name: Software Download Time Limit
parameters.description: Time at which the software download clock rolls over back to 0 Minutes 0 seconds.

parameters.name: Temporary Speed Restriction Effective Time Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC167 seconds after the on-board segment receives the bulletin or TBC248 after the temporary speed restriction goes into effect.

parameters.name: Work Zone Effective Time Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for a 0 mph work zone target until at least TBC249 seconds after the work zone goes into effect. See also Work Zone Target Receipt of Dataset / State Change Enforcement Delay TBC161.

parameters.name: Track Out of Service Effective Time Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC242 seconds after the on-board segment receives the bulletin or TBC250 seconds after the bulletin goes into effect.

parameters.name: Grade Crossing Activation Failure Effective Time Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC243 seconds after the bulletin containing the grade crossing warning system malfunction is received or TBC251 seconds after the bulletin containing the grade crossing warning system malfunction goes into effect.

parameters.name: Grade Crossing False Activation Effective Time Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for a grade crossing false activation target until at least TBC252 seconds after the bulletin containing the grade crossing warning system malfunction goes into effect. See also Grade Crossing False Activation Receipt of Dataset / State Change Enforcement Delay TBC244.

parameters.name: In-Train Brake Cylinder Pressures
parameters.description: The upper limit of display of in train brake cylinder pressure. Any BCP above TBC253 will be displayed at TBC253.

parameters.name: Duplicate BOS Message Detection Period
parameters.description: On-board discards any message with same type, number, address, and integrity as a previously accepted message received within TBC254 seconds. When sending messages to BOS, on-board will generate a different correlation ID from any ID generated in the last TBC254 seconds.

parameters.name: Violation No Longer Reported Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC255 seconds after the violation is no longer reported.

parameters.name: WIUStatus Message Advance Limit
parameters.description: On-board will discard any WIUStatus message with a creation time more than TBC256 seconds in the future of the time the message was received.

parameters.name: Passenger Predictor Curve Nominal Warning Time
parameters.description: At current throttle and brake settings, the on-board will begin warning when it calculates there is TBC257 seconds before braking is required to be enforced.

parameters.name: Commuter Predictor Curve Nominal Warning Time
parameters.description: At current throttle and brake settings, the on-board will begin warning when it calculates there is TBC258 seconds before braking is required to be enforced.

parameters.name: Maximum Log File Retention Maximum amount of time the on-board keeps log files
Maximum CDU Log File Storage Capacity
parameters.description: On-board deletes oldest files when stored CDU logs exceed TBC260 MB

parameters.name: WSRS Subscription Timeframe
parameters.description: On-board will remain subscribed to a WSRS for TBC261 seconds from the time of sending a subscribe message. Any attempts to unsubscribe will continue for this duration.

parameters.name: Elapsed time since receiving WSRS Subscription Confirmation message
parameters.description: If a device monitored by a WIU via WSRS is still on the train's calculated route after TBC262 seconds, the on-board will send another WSRS Subscribe message. Note: this time frame should be less than WSRS Subscription Timeframe set in message.

parameters.name: WSRS Subscription Message Timeout
parameters.description: On-board will resend the WSRS Subscribe message if no confirmation is received within TBC263 seconds

parameters.name: WSRS Unsubscribe Message Timeout
parameters.description: On-board will resend the WSRS Unsubscribe message if no confirmation is received within TBC264 seconds, and less than TBC261 seconds has elapsed since a WSRS Subscribe message has been sent

parameters.name: WSRS Backup Enabled subscription timeout due to loss of WIUStatus (5100) messages
parameters.description: On-board will send a WSRS Subscribe message to a WSRS backup enabled WIU if it has not received a valid WIUStatus message within the past TBC266 seconds

parameters.name: Approach Lighting Timeout
parameters.description: Minimum time since passing facing signal in approach to a dark, absolute, intermediate stop and proceed, or intermediate restricted signal before target generation

parameters.name: Crossing Malfunction Activation Failure Second Protection Prompt Distance
parameters.description: After the crew has indicated once that a crossing in a crossing activation failure target is not protected, the distance to that target the train must be within for the on-board segment to display a second prompt to indicate that the crossing is protected.

parameters.name: Allowable Rollback Distance
parameters.description: Distance train can travel in opposite direction before on-board sets location and direction to unknown.

parameters.name: Unknown Direction of Movement Target Enforcement Delay
Departure Test Start Minimum Threshold with Feed Valve Setting
parameters.description: Front brake pipe pressure must be above the feed valve setting minus this number to initiate a brake test.

parameters.name: Switch Resolution Prompt Delay
parameters.description: On-board will wait TBC288 seconds after the position of a monitored switch becomes unknown before prompting. This prevents a switch resolution prompt from being displayed, for example, when a hand throw switch is in the process of being thrown.

parameters.name: Overspeed Warning Limit for Restricted Speed Targets
parameters.description: When predictively enforcing a restricted speed target, the current speed in relation to the target speed at which warning may be initiated. When reactively enforcing a restricted speed target, the speed in relation to the target speed at which warning is initiated.

parameters.name: Overspeed Braking Limit for Restricted Speed Targets
parameters.description: When predictively enforcing a restricted speed target, the projected speed in relation to target speed at the target limit at which warning or braking may be initiated. Also, when predictively enforcing a restricted speed target, the current speed in relation to the target speed at which braking may be initiated. When reactively enforcing a restricted speed target, the speed in relation to the target speed at which braking is initiated.

parameters.name: Predictive Warning Removal Limit for Restricted Speed Targets
parameters.description: The current speed in relation to the target speed at which a warning is removed.

parameters.name: Speed Enforcement Cab Signal Freight Speed Enforcement Delay Time
parameters.description: Utilized on speed enforcement cab signal track to calculate an enforcement delay for a freight train equal to: (current stopping time x ((current speed – target speed) / current speed)) + TBC294 seconds when the cab signal changes and the train speed is faster than the speed associated with the new cab signal status.

parameters.name: Speed Enforcement Cab Signal Passenger Speed Enforcement Delay Time
parameters.description: Utilized on speed enforcement cab signal track to calculate an enforcement delay for a passenger train equal to: (current stopping time x ((current speed – target speed) / current speed)) + TBC295 seconds when the cab signal changes and the train speed is faster than the speed associated with the new cab signal status.

parameters.name: Cab Signal Restricted Distance
parameters.description: The train will be required to travel the greater of the train length or this many feet after a restricting cab signal indication upgrades.

parameters.name: Clear to Next Interlocking Speed for Freight
parameters.description: The maximum authorized speed when a clear to next interlocking indication is received from a signal.

parameters.name: Clear to Next Interlocking Speed for Passenger
parameters.description: The maximum authorized speed when a clear to next interlocking indication is received from a signal.

parameters.name: Maximum Speed for Time Based Horn Protection
parameters.description: The speed at or below which the on-board segment logic for horn protection is based on time from crossing and above which the on-board segment logic for horn protection is based on time and distance from crossing

parameters.name: Horn Protection Activation Distance Threshold
parameters.description: The distance from a crossing that the on-board segment will activate horn protection when the train speed is above Maximum Speed for Time Based Horn Protection

parameters.name: Unknown Switch Position Target Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for an unknown switch position target • Until at least TBC303 seconds after the on-board segment state transitions from DISENGAGED to ACTIVE and • Until at least TBC303 seconds after the unknown switch position target is generated inside a restricted speed cab signal target.

parameters.name: Conditional Movement Authority Target Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for a conditional movement authority target until at least TBC304 seconds after the on-board segment state transitions from DISENGAGED to ACTIVE.

parameters.name: Restricted Speed Signal Target Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur for a restricted speed signal target until at least (current stopping time x ((current speed - target speed) / current speed)) + TBC305 seconds after the on-board segment state transitions from DISENGAGED to ACTIVE.

parameters.name: CHM Class D Data Ack Timeout
parameters.description: The number of milliseconds to wait for a Data Acknowledgement before timing out

parameters.name: Unintended State Change Speed Reduction Period
parameters.description: The period for which the on-board segment will warn before initiating a full-service brake application if the train speed is above TBC308/TBC402 mph following an “unintended” transition from the ACTIVE state to the DISENGAGED, CUT OUT or FAILED state.

parameters.name: Tolerance for Bunching Moves
parameters.description: The distance that the on-board segment will allow the train to move opposite the direction authorized by a directional form-based authority without enforcement braking when CFG1 is disabled. Also the distance the on-board segment will allow the train to move after changing direction in a work zone without enforcement braking when CFG3 is disabled. Also the distance the on-board segment will allow the train to move opposite the direction in which it entered a signal block before enforcing restricted speed until the leading edge of the train leaves that signal block, regardless of any subsequent change in direction.

parameters.name: PTC Suspension Receipt of Dataset / State Change Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC312 seconds after the on-board segment receives the bulletin or TBC313 after the PTC suspension bulletin goes into effect.

parameters.name: PTC Suspension Effective Time Enforcement Delay
parameters.description: The enforcement delay ensures that enforcement braking does not occur until at least TBC312 seconds after the on-board segment receives the bulletin or TBC313 after the PTC suspension bulletin goes into effect.

parameters.name: Target Approach Management Freight Approach Distance
parameters.description: The distance from a zero speed target at which the on-board segment may suspend predictive enforcement for a zero speed target per the target approach management function on a train of type “freight” or “intermodal”.

parameters.name: Target Approach Management Freight Maximum Speed
parameters.description: The speed at or below which the on-board segment may suspend predictive enforcement for a zero speed target per the target approach management function on a train of type “freight” or “intermodal”.

parameters.name: Reverse Movement outside Signal Block Prompt Distance
parameters.description: The distance to the signal governing exit from a signal block the train must be within for the on-board segment to display a prompt to indicate that they have permission to make such a move.

parameters.name: Maximum distance for retaining recorded locomotive track location
parameters.description: The maximum distance the on-board segment will allow the train to move in the Initializing state before discarding any locomotive track location it has retained in memory. Once discarded that locomotive track location is no longer available when the on-board segment determines the locomotive track location upon transition out of the Initializing state.

parameters.name: Signal Target Removal Distance When Cab Signal More Permissive
parameters.description: The distance the locomotive must travel past a restricted speed signal target, a restricted speed enter main track target, or a SG-3 soft target before a more permissive cab signal target will be considered to take precedence by the on-board.

parameters.name: Reactive Braking Hold Off for Non-zero Speed Targets
Minimum Nominal Warning Time
parameters.description: The on-board segment adjusts its warning distance calculation to ensure TBC388 seconds of nominal warning time prior to predictive enforcement braking.

parameters.name: Aggregate CRC Mismatch and Composite CRC Mismatch Hold Off Time
parameters.description: Time allowed for an aggregate CRC mismatch or a composite CRC mismatch to be cleared before the on-board segment sets the subdivision/district to “non synchronized.” A value of 0 indicates that there is no hold off time and the on-board segment sets the subdivision/district to “non synchronized” immediately upon detection of an aggregate CRC mismatch or a composite CRC mismatch. Note that the on-board segment will detect a composite CRC mismatch only when CFG37 is enabled for the railroad operating the subdivision/district.

parameters.name: Approaching Exit Notification Distance
parameters.description: The distance in approach to the exit from PTC controlled track that the notification is displayed.

parameters.name: Tolerance for Train Handling in Work Zone
parameters.description: The time that the on-board segment will allow the train to stop within a work zone the crew has already confirmed permission to enter before again generating a zero speed target over that work zone.

parameters.name: Target Approach Management Passenger Approach Distance
parameters.description: The distance from a zero speed target at which the on-board segment may suspend predictive enforcement for a zero speed target per the target approach management function on a train of type “passenger”, “commuter”, “high speed passenger”, or “tilt train”.

parameters.name: Target Approach Management Passenger Maximum Speed
parameters.description: The speed at or below which the on-board segment may suspend predictive enforcement for a zero speed target per the target approach management function on a train of type “passenger”, “commuter”, “high speed passenger”, or “tilt train”.

parameters.name: Expanded XTE Limit
parameters.description: A larger cross track limit used to increase the number of potential track options when the crew is selecting track location and no track options are within TBC185 of the locomotive’s GPS position.

parameters.name: Acceptable Along-Route Distance for GPS Fix
parameters.description: The along-route distance a valid GPS fix can be from the current locomotive track location before setting the location to unknown in DISENGAGED or generating an unknown location target in ACTIVE.

parameters.name: Prompt for continued movement in Restricted state distance
parameters.description: The distance that a locomotive may travel since the locomotive last stopped or the crew last acknowledged a prompt for continued movement in Restricted state before being prompted to continue movement in Restricted state.

parameters.name: Prompt response time for continued movement in Restricted state
parameters.description: The time allowed for the crew to respond to a prompt for continued movement in Restricted state before the on-board segment will command a full-service brake application.

parameters.name: Maximum leading end track solution count
Transition to Restricted state enforcement delay
Pending Prompts Timeout

parameters.name: Hold Off for Signals within the Calculated Position Uncertainty of the Leading Edge of the Train When Stopped
parameters.description: When the locomotive has been stopped for at least TBC412 seconds, the on-board segment will accept status updates from wayside signals within the calculated position uncertainty of the leading edge of the train and update its signal targets accordingly. If the locomotive has been stopped for at least TBC412 seconds and the on-board segment state is Disengaged, the on-board segment will not: • Replace a zero (0) mph signal based target with a restricted speed signal based target when the leading edge of the train is within the calculated position uncertainty of that target • Generate a becoming located signal target for a signal block within the calculated position uncertainty in advance of the leading edge of the train The locomotive must be stopped for at least TBC412 seconds for the on-board segment to store the last known signal target status upon a transition to Cut Out or Restricted state. If the locomotive has been stopped for at least TBC412 seconds and the on-board segment state is Active and the leading edge of the train is within calculated position uncertainty in approach to or inside of a zero (0) mph signal target or zero (0) mph unknown signal target and prompting is not enabled in the track data for the signal associated with that target, the on-board segment will prompt the crew that the signal status is preventing train movement.

parameters.name: Timeout to Remove Last Known Signal Target from Memory
parameters.description: When TBC421 minutes have elapsed since the on-board segment stored a signal target at a transition to Initializing, Cut Out or Restricted state and the locomotive track location and direction of movement are still unknown, the on-board segment will remove the retained signal target from memory. This prevents the on-board segment from retaining signal target status beyond, for example, the expected length of a crew change. Note that TBC421 is only in effect when CFG29 is enabled for the operating railroad where the leading edge of the train was located at the time of the state transition to Initializing, Cut Out or Restricted.

parameters.name: Obtain Signal Status Enforcement Delay

The on-board segment enforces a stop prior to the crossing.

parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Retain Signal Target Status
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment retains signal target status upon transition to CUT OUT or RESTRICTED state and re-instates the signal target upon re-establishing a known locomotive track location, assuming all conditions for doing so are met as detailed in the on-board segment requirements. Disabled: The on-board segment does not retain signal target status upon transition to CUT OUT or RESTRICTED state. An operating railroad may choose to disable this functionality, for example, to ensure consistent behavior of the on-board segment on locomotives equipped with active and passive wheel tachometers. An active tachometer is a condition for retaining signal target status.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Enable Crew Selection from Multiple Pending Prompts with "View All Prompts" Key
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Enforce restricted speed for longer of train length or TBC296 ft after cab signal upgrades
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment enforces restricted speed for the longer of train length or TBC296 ft after the cab signal upgrades from restricting. Disabled: The on-board segment immediately enforces the speed associated with the new cab signal status when the cab signal upgrades from restricting.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Enable MTEA Speed Enforcement for Owning Railroad
parameters.description: The on-board segment enforces MTEA speed when the on-board segment is Disengaged and not navigating when CFG34 is enabled by the owning railroad and CFG35 is enabled by all operating railroads selected for initialization. Otherwise, the on-board segment does not enforce MTEA speed.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Enable MTEA Speed Enforcement for Operating Railroad
parameters.description: The on-board segment enforces MTEA speed when the on-board segment is Disengaged and not navigating when CFG34 is enabled by the owning railroad and CFG35 is enabled by all operating railroads selected for initialization. Otherwise, the on-board segment does not enforce MTEA speed.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Generate shoving move speed restriction
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment generates a shoving move speed restriction target when the train orientation is “reverse”. Disabled: The on-board segment does not generate a shoving move speed restriction target when the train orientation is “reverse”. See also TBC417 and TBC418.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Enable IC3 Functionality
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment evaluates the IC3 CRC and IC3 Uniqueness Index fields in the messages it receives from the back office. The on-board segment sends a Poll Response (02021) message in response to the Office Segment Poll (01021) message. Disabled: The on-board segment ignores the IC3 CRC and IC3 Uniqueness Index fields in the messages it receives from the back office. The on-board segment does not send a Poll Response (02021) message in response to the Office Segment Poll (01021) message.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Target Dark Signal in Advance of SG-5 Signal Immediately
parameters.description: Enabled: When a dark signal follows a signal with an indication in SG-5 on the train’s calculated route, the on-board segment will generate a target for the dark signal immediately without waiting for the leading edge of the train to pass the last facing signal in approach to the dark signal. Disabled: When a dark signal follows a signal with an indication in SG-5 on the train’s calculated route, the on-board segment will wait until TBC269 seconds have elapsed since the leading edge of the train passed the last facing signal in approach to the dark signal before generating a target for the dark signal. CFG38 is provided to accommodate railroads which may have mapped a signal indication which would normally be in SG-3 to SG-5. Enabling CFG38 ensures that the on-board segment targets a dark signal following such a signal early enough to provide timely enforcement at the dark signal.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Restrict Navigation Module Messaging to NMEA
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment restricts messaging with the navigation modules to use NMEA formatted messages only. Disabled: The on-board segment allows additional messaging formats such as S-9103 with the navigation modules.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Disallow Acceptance of Wayside Signal Status behind the Calculated Train Leading Edge Location When Stopped
parameters.description: Enabled: When the locomotive has been stopped for at least TBC412 seconds, the on-board segment will accept WIUStatus messages from signals on the train’s calculated route between the leading edge of the train and the end of the train’s calculated route. Disabled: When the locomotive has been stopped for at least TBC412 seconds, the on-board segment will accept WIUStatus messages from signals on the train’s calculated route between a point at the calculated position uncertainty behind the leading edge of the train and the end of the train’s calculated route.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Enable generation of end of form based authority on signaled track target
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment generates a zero (0) mph ‘end of form based authority on signaled track’ target at the end of an authority on track that is signaled in the train’s direction of movement and does not require form based authority in the train’s direction of movement and no facing signal or additional form based authority is coincident with the end of that authority to provide authority for the train to exit that authority. Disabled: The on-board segment does not generate a zero (0) mph ‘end of form based authority on signaled track’ target. A railroad may choose to disable this CFG, for example, if their operating rules allow a train to proceed based on the indication of the last facing signal within the limits of an authority on track that is signaled in the train’s direction of movement and does not require form based authority in the train’s direction of movement even if there is no facing signal coincident with the exit limit of that authority.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Limit generation of end of form based authority on signaled track targets to bidirectional authorities
parameters.description: Enabled: When CFG42 and CFG43 are enabled, the on-board segment generates a zero (0) mph ‘end of form based authority on signaled track’ target only at the end of a bidirectional authority. Disabled: When CFG42 is enabled and CFG43 is disabled, the board segment generates a zero (0) mph ‘end of form based authority on signaled track’ target at the end of directional authorities and bidirectional authorities.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Enable logging of messages exchanged between PTC and EM
parameters.description: Enabled: Messages exchanged between the on-board segment and Energy Management are logged. Disabled: Messages exchanged between the on-board segment and Energy Management are not logged.

parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Include valid LIG BPP2 as input to Front Brake Pipe Pressure determination
parameters.description: Enabled: On a locomotive with a LIG control system and available BPP2 input, the on-board segment includes valid BPP2 input in the determination of a Front Brake Pipe Pressure value. Disabled: On a locomotive with a LIG control system and available BPP2 input, the on-board segment omits the BPP2 input from the determination of a Front Brake Pipe Pressure value.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Re-alert Enabled
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment sounds additional audible alerts after the initial audible alert when the locomotive is stopped with the reverser handle in the forward or reverse position and a prompt for a zero (0) mph target is displayed. Disabled: The on-board segment does not sound additional audible alerts after the initial audible alert when a prompt for a zero (0) mph target is displayed. See also TBC456.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Perform multi-parameter consist checks
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment checks combinations of consist values to ensure they are consistent and prompts the crew to correct errors when they are detected. Disabled: The on-board segment does not perform the consist checks described above.
parameters.railroad: Operating railroad that provided the summary consist data

parameters.name: Licensed Feature Civil Speed Enabled
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Crossing Protection Canada
parameters.description: Enabled: For a grade crossing on track with country of operation Canada and CFG61 enabled, the on-board segment prompts for the required protection at the crossing, either manual protection required or maximum authorized speed. Disabled: For a grade crossing on track with country of operation Canada and CFG61 disabled, the on-board segment either prompts for the required speed at the crossing if CFG27 is enabled (either stop and warn required, TBC30 mph or maximum authorized speed) or does not prompt for required speed at the crossing if CFG27 is disabled.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Reverse Move Restricted Speed Canada
parameters.description: Enabled: When the country of operation is Canada and CFG65 is enabled, the on-board segment will enforce restricted speed when the train orientation changes in a signal block and when the train has moved more than TBC310 feet opposite the direction in which the train entered the signal block as it does when the country of operation is other than Canada. Disabled: When the country of operation is Canada and CFG65 is disabled, the on-board segment will not enforce restricted speed when the train orientation changes in a signal block nor when the train has moved more than TBC310 feet opposite the direction in which the train entered the signal block
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: PSS No Stop Required
parameters.description: Enabled: When the country of operation is Canada and CFG66 is enabled for the operating railroad, the on-board segment does not require the train to be stopped before applying a movement authority dataset of type Pass Signal at Stop, CROR PSS No Equipment or CROR PSS Equipment. Disabled: When the country of operation is Canada and CFG66 is disabled for the operating railroad, the on-board segment requires the train to be stopped before applying a movement authority dataset of type Pass Signal at Stop, CROR PSS No Equipment or CROR PSS Equipment.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: PSS Manual Prompt Speed Selection
parameters.description: Enabled: When the country of operation is Canada and CFG67 is enabled for the operating railroad, the on-board segment will prompt the crew to indicate the speed to be enforced after authorized to pass a signal at stop. Disabled: When the country of operation is Canada and CFG67 is disabled for the operating railroad, the on-board segment will not prompt the crew to indicate the speed to be enforced after authorized to pass a signal at stop. The prompts displayed for passing a signal at stop match those displayed when the country of operation is other than Canada.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Upgrade Signal in Bidirectional Authority
parameters.description: Enabled: The on-board segment replaces a zero (0) mph signal target with a restricted speed signal target or a zero (0) mph unknown signal target with a restricted speed unknown signal target at an absolute non-interlocking signal when • the leading edge of the train is within TBC40 mph feet plus the calculated position uncertainty of a signal and • that signal is on track with country of operation Canada and • that signal is on track that is signaled in the train’s direction of movement but does not require form-based authority in the train’s direction of movement and • that signal is inside but not coterminous with the limits of a bidirectional authority and • that signal is not the last signal on the train’s calculated route in approach to: o the end of the bidirectional authority or o the end of track signaled in the train’s direction of movement o the end of PTC track or o the end of the train’s calculated route. Disabled: The on-board segment requires authority to pass signal at stop for a signal with the criteria listed above in order to replace a zero (0) mph signal target or a zero (0) mph unknown signal target at that signal.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Current speed display with one decimal resolution.
parameters.description: Enabled: The onboard current speed is displayed rounded down to one decimal. Disabled: The onboard current speed is displayed rounded down to a whole number.
parameters.section: 3.1 Railroad TBC Values and Functional Parameters

parameters.name: Acceleration rate display.
parameters.description: Enabled: The onboard acceleration rate is displayed on top the CDU, below the current speed. Disabled: The onboard will not display the acceleration rate.
